study: Garet et al. 2008, Early Reading PD Interventions (LETRS institute +/- coaching), NCEE 2008-4030
eval_evidence: Research team = AIR (prime) + MDRC + REDA International, with no financial stake; the PD itself was delivered by separate providers (Sopris West LETRS, CORE).
developer_evidence: Sopris West's LETRS team and the Consortium on Reading Excellence (CORE) 'delivered the teacher and coach PD'; the program providers (PD/coaching developers) delivered directly, not the school system.
cascade_evidence: LETRS facilitators (Sopris West) delivered the 8-day institute series to teachers; CORE-trained in-school coaches worked directly with teachers. PD reached teachers via the providers' own facilitators/coaches, not a teacher train-the-trainer chain.
counterfactual_evidence: Three-arm design with a 'business as usual control condition'; controls continued their district's regular PD (could seek out other reading PD).
coaching_evidence: ARM-VARYING: Treatment A (row 32, institute only) = none; Treatment B (row 33, institute + coaching) = a half-time in-school coach per school (~5.9 teachers/coach, expected ~60 hrs/yr, multi-step in-class coaching cycle). Coded frequent_inclass for the coaching arm; note arm A has no coaching.
student_dose_evidence: PD targets grade-2 teachers' early-reading instruction (knowledge/practice); no tutoring/pull-out/extra student minutes or student software dose introduced.
maturity_evidence: Primary extracted wave = Implementation Year (Spring 2006), the first year teachers received the PD; a separate Follow-Up Year (Spring 2007) is reported but not extracted as primary.
